n.description: integer Additional keyword arguments to be passed to ``factorint``. Since ``kwargs`` is new in version 1.13, ``limit`` and ``verbose`` are retained for compatibility purposes.
constraints: n must be a positive integer

limit.description: maximum number of factors returned, if provided. Defaults to no limit.
constraints: limit and verbose are optional parameters

verbose.description: whether or not to print verbose output
constraints: limit and verbose are optional parameters

output.description: ======= list(int) : List of prime numbers dividing ``n``

constraints: limit and verbose are optional parameters
